tspan.tspan: 接入投前多模态预筛漏斗

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
批量生成 50~200 套 AIGC 广告素材
(短视频前3秒黄金帧 / 信息流海报)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 直接全量上传巨量引擎/Meta 测试？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
80% 废片白白消耗 $38,500+ 冷启动预算
整体账户 ROAS 被严重拖累

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 1: 平台 UI 安全区遮挡掩码校验
(拦截被抖音右侧图标/底部文案遮挡的素材)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 2: DeepGaze III 500ms 视网膜眼动仿真
计算 1st→2nd→3rd 眼跳与 AOI 注意力积分

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
背景干扰物夺焦 > 15% 或
CTA 首次到达 > 1,000ms？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
自动触发 f/1.8 深度景深虚化 + 暗角压暗
重跑眼动直至 SKU 注视占比 >= 45%

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Stage 3: Pairwise Bradley-Terry VLM 两两对战
+ 历史行业 CTR/ROAS 归因校准头

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
按 Elo 积分与 pCTR 排序
仅放行 Top 20% S 级素材进入真机买量
